name: Xanlight
description: Xanlight is a deep-core system, steady enough for beacons and strange enough for rumors. Tidal kneading keeps the inner planets restless, and quake swarms punctuate the long quiet. Claim jumpers whisper about a world that charts itself differently every survey.

stars.name: Low Brand
stars.description: A brown-dwarf of 0.03074 solar masses, planet-like atmosphere against the dark. It radiates leftover formation heat, cooling a fraction each century. Every chart in the arm uses it as a bearing star, willing or not.

planets.name: Obsidianholm
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Storms the size of continents roll unbroken around the equator. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

moons.name: Vapor Rubble I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

moons.name: Pale Pebble II
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

moons.name: Meridian Scree V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Palefell
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Subsurface warmth is rumored, and twice confirmed, and never shared. Pilots time their burns to the pulsar remnant next door, when the static clears.

asteroids.name: Crag 950
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

asteroids.name: Pebble 21
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

comets.name: Lost Promise
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
